facility.name: Shepherd of the Hills Lutheran
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,After School Care,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 6914 WURZBACH RD, SAN ANTONIO, TX, 78240

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records: The director informed me that the two individuals left in charge in the directors absences would not be aware of the location of the staff and children's files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records (26 TAC §746.1013(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Nine Inches if Equipment Greater Than 5 Ft.: The loose-fill under and around the swings is not installed to the required depth of nine inches within the use zone.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Nine Inches if Equipment Greater Than 5 Ft. (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: On two of the playgrounds the loose-fill was not installed to the required depth of six inches.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: Recite: Ten of the staff files reviewed had a CPR certification that was completed through an online source, which did not include hands-on training.   Noted: seven updated CPR certifications were submitted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: Ten of the staff files reviewed had a CPR certification that was completed through an online source, that did not include hands-on training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Ten staff files reviewed were found to be missing the following information; showing he has received a copy of the child-care center s: Operational policies and Personnel policies, A copy of a photo identification/ A copy of the person's current driver's license if the person transports a child in care, and A statement signed and dated by the employee verifying the date the employee attended training during orientation that includes an overview of your policy on the prevention, recognition, and reporting of child maltreatment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Several of the children's files were missing required information for their emergency contacts; physical addresses.   This was corrected during inspection when parents were contacted via phone to update information verbally.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Recite: Five of the nine caregiver files reviewed lacked documentation of training certificates demonstrating the required 24 hours of annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Seven of the nine caregiver files reviewed lacked documentation of training certificates demonstrating the required 24 hours of annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Licensing Parent Notification Poster: The Parent Notifiation Poster was not visably posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Licensing Parent Notification Poster (26 TAC §746.401(7))

occurrences.finding: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection: The operation did not have a current gas inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5401)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation's most recent fire inspection was completed on July 2, 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Telephone Numbers: Required telephone numbers were not visibly posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Telephone Numbers (26 TAC §746.401(8))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: Form 2885, Children Product Certification form was observed to be signed January 4th, 2024.   Noted: this was corrected at inspection when the CPSC recalls were reviewed and the form was signed and dated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement: When reviewing children's files the information on special care needs for children was not available for review.  In ten out of ten children's files reviewed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Reviewing children's files, the information for the emergency contact person's address was not available for review.  In ten out of ten children's files reviewed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Two of the ten staff files did not have training certificates available for review for the most recently completed training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: One of the ten staff files reviewed did not include training in required topics, such as; emergency preparedness, communicable diseases, medication administration, food allergies, physical premises, and hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Required Vehicle Documentation - date of lease or purchase for each vehicle: Proof of one of the vehicles purchases was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Vehicle Documentation - date of lease or purchase for each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5627)

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: When reviewing directors file the following were not available for review: Emergency Prep., Communicable Disease, Administering medication, Food allergies, Building and physical premises, Hazardous Materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely: There was a seatbelt in the last seat in the back on the right side behind the diver that is broken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely (26 TAC §746.5603(c))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle: Vehicles used to transport vehicles were purchased 7/2024 and did not have child safety alarms installed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training: An individual required to have two hours of transportation did not have certificates available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months: A person required who is required to have training in topics related to caring for children 24 months and under did not have certificates for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months (26 TAC §746.1311(d))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: Six of the ten staff files were reviewed did not have current CPR/First aid certification.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: There were several metal railroad ties sticking up out of the base of the black lining of the playground that could cause injury to children.   *Corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Food not a reward: It was determined through an investigation that caregivers were using food items as a reward for good behavior.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Food not a reward (26 TAC §746.3301(h))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: It was determined in the investigation that a caregiver was using prohibited punishment when she was yelling at the children in her care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: Outlets in Pre-K rooms were observed to be uncovered.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over: A television was observed to be sat on top of crate on a shelf and was not anchored.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over (26 TAC §746.3701(10))

occurrences.finding: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies: Nine of the ten children's files reviewed did not include verification of receipt of the operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies (26 TAC §746.503)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: The ten files reviewed did not include necessary information for the listed emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The operation did not have a current Form 2885 Child Product Certification.   Noted: The CPSC recall list was reviewed during the inspection and the Form 2885 was signed and posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission: The ten files reviewed did not include the date of admission.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §746.605(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans: The operational polcies/Parent handbook did not include the emergency prepardness plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans (26 TAC §746.501(a)(24))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Dates of Employment: Seven of the ten staff files did not include employment begin dates.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Dates of Employment (26 TAC §746.901(1))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: One file did not include current immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: Ten of the children's files did not include emerceny care authorization.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: Two of the ten staff files did not include the employment affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt: Children who are toilet learning, were sent home in soiled diapers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt (26 TAC §746.3501(1))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: In two classrooms, two children were observed to not have their hands washed after diapering.   Noted: This was correct during inspection when the teachers were advised to wash children's hands after diapering.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: Children were observed utilizing chairs that were manufactured with straps/bkuckles but children were not buckled into the seats.   Noted: This was corrected at inspection when the children were removed from the seats.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based upon the information gathered through interviews the lack of supervision and knowledge of an incident that occurred on the PreK playground as teachers are sitting on the bench not supervising.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A caregiver was observed changing a diaper and did not wash the hands of the child after diapering.   Noted: this was corrected during inspection when the caregiver washed the child's hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt: Two children were reported to be sent home in soiled clothing after having a toileting accident.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt (26 TAC §746.3501(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: Caregivers have been using yelling as a form of discipline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: After conducting interviews, it was confirmed that during drop off times, classrooms were left out of ratio for extended periods of time after notifying administration.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: After interviews, three individuals confirmed caregivers using personal devices while caring for children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: After conducting interviews, it was confirmed by six individuals that during drop-off times classrooms were left out of ratio for extended periods of time after notifying administration.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: After being made aware of an incident of possible inappropriate discipline, the operation did not self-report to CCR staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Employees Comply with Standards: After being made aware of possible improper discipline, director did not follow up with making sure employees were complaint with standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Employees Comply with Standards (26 TAC §746.1003(2))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: A caregiver used corporal punishment with a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: A caregiver was heard yelling at children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: There was a thermometer that was missing from the first aid kit located on the bus used to transport children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: There was a fire extinguisher on the bus, meant to transport children, that had not been serviced since August 2013.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: There was no documentation of drills that occurred in April, or May of this year 2022 available for review.    Note: This was corrected at inspection when the director added in the date in which the fire dill was conducted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: There was not an electronic child safety alarm that was installed in the bus used to transport children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: There was less then 6 inches of loose fill material underneath the climbing bars, rock wall tee-pee, and where the slide exits were located, on the playground for the 2 year olds through 4 year olds.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))
